response:
In fervent fervor, I fervently pray,
That fiery fervor may find its way,
To kindle kindness, to spark the soul,
And set aflame the fervent heart's goal.

I don't want to set, the world on fire,
With fervent fervor, that may tire,
But rather start, a flame in your heart,
A gentle glow, that will never depart.

In fervent fervor, I fervently implore,
That love and light, may forever roar,
And though the world, may be in strife,
Your heart may burn, with fervent, fiery life.
